title: Budget-Manager
description: Budget Manager combines payment automation with enforced financial discipline. It turns financial plans into scheduled actions while restricting access to committed funds until agreed release conditions are met. Individuals and families can protect rent, school fees and savings goals, release allowances gradually, and automate recurring support. Freelancers can organize irregular income, while businesses can group and schedule salaries, contractor payments and other obligations—with clear funding choices and recorded transaction outcomes.
technologies:
Backend:	Python + FastAPI
Application server:	Uvicorn
Frontend:	HTML

CSS and JavaScript
Templates:	Jinja2
Database:	SQLite
Payments:	Paystack API
HTTP client:	HTTPX
Token verification:	PyJWT with cryptography
Deployment:	Docker + Docker Compose
HTTPS and routing:	Caddy
Hosting:	AWS Ubuntu server
Automation	Cron + Python workers
